subject: Genetics
title: Sickle Cell and Advantage
description: One-minute skill: Sickle Cell and Advantage.

hook.text: Sickle cell disease is devastating. But carrying one copy of the gene protects you from malaria. A dark bargain.

buildup.text: The sickle allele warps red blood cells into crescents. Two copies cause anemia, pain crises, and early death.

discovery.text: One copy gives mild sickling but makes red blood cells hostile to malaria parasites. Carriers survive malaria better.

twist.text: In malaria zones, carrying one sickle allele is an advantage. Natural selection keeps the deadly allele alive.

climax.text: This is called heterozygote advantage. A gene that kills in double dose saves lives in single dose.

punchline.text: One copy kills disease. Two copies cause one.

quiz.question: Why does the sickle cell allele persist in malaria regions?
